title: רב חמא בר ברתיה דחסא

paragraphs: Rav Chama, son of Chasa's daughter—Ein Yaakov has Chama—related to Rav Kahana that Rabbah bar Nachmani died because of persecution: Bava Metzia 86a. “A great man in Rav Nachman's time” means that Chasa was a great man in Rav Nachman's time; see there.
